model_result.answer_summary: Tick the right-hand 1C4 chair. K is neutral, closed-shell heptakis(3,6-anhydro)-beta-cyclodextrin: each of seven alpha-(1->4)-linked alpha-D-gluco repeats has a C3-O-C6 bridge and C2-OH as its only free hydroxyl, with all carbon configurations retained (formula C42H56O28).
assumptions: Problem input: beta-cyclodextrin consists of seven alpha-D-glucopyranosyl units joined by alpha-(1->4) glycosidic bonds.
Problem input: the reaction uses TsCl (7 equivalents) in pyridine, then aqueous NaOH at 60 degrees C, and K has one free OH per glucopyranosyl unit.
Trusted general chemistry: one equivalent of TsCl per beta-CD repeat gives per-6-O-tosylation under the printed pyridine conditions.
Trusted general chemistry: warm aqueous hydroxide converts each C3-OH/C6-OTs pair into a C3-O-C6 intramolecular ether and that bridge constrains the glucopyranosyl unit to the 1C4 chair.
Lean logical dependencies reported by #print axioms are limited to propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound for structure_K; chair_conformation has no axioms.
